title: A World of Dark Comedy 3

places.quote: “That cash? That is for the winner of the challenge.”

audience_comments: All films had me non stop laughing.
Good dark humour, and deep. Some over the top.
Very well made films, well arranged.
Some get better the 2nd time, but the awkward ones are still awkward.
Great night, I will never look at a cooked chicken the same way again!
Really, really hard to choose only 3…. excellent!
This is world class! Well done!
Come all the time – love it.
Great stories and a different side of comedy. see you at the Oscars!
Great films, hard to choose best.
Great films, Awesome line up! Love, love, love,
Amazingly good – and I have been before!
The level of filmmaking, scripting & performances are extraordinary – all very good.

films.title: Zombies v the CWA
credits: Cast – Andy Bramble, Marilyn Brack, Andy Bramble +
synopsis: A Country Women’s Association meeting is rudely interrupted by a sudden zombie outbreak, and the ladies must take up arms to battle the undead horde.

films.title: Perfect Specimen
credits: Cast – Simon Lee, Al Dukes, Eliza Logan
synopsis: Edward James is the proud founder, CEO and sole employee of Perfect Specimen, a digital platform via which he sells his sperm to want-to-be mothers looking to birth ‘exceptional quality offspring’. And, whilst he’s succeeded in building a reasonably successful business, his work has come between him and any kind of meaningful relationship with a female partner.
Thus alone, and increasingly lonely, in turmoil and with an uncertain path ahead, Edward is facing a uniquely potent midlife crisis.

films.title: Dinner For Two
synopsis: A man prepares a roast chicken for a date – or so it seems.

films.title: The Wheel of Satan
credits: Director, Producer & Writers – Jacob Fischer Laursen, Asger Kjeldsen, Jes Bergholt Bach & Magnus Lund
Cast – Jacob Fischer Laursen, Jes Bergholt Bach & Magnus Lund
synopsis: Faced by Satan demanding the ultimate sacrifice, three young satanists must make a choice of fatal consequence.
Photography – Asger Kjeldsen

films.title: Little Rocker
synopsis: A teenage fan accidentally kills his favourite rock star in the backstage bathroom and must decide what to do with the body before the show starts.

films.title: Rubbish Robbers
credits: Cast – Calle Hellevang-Larsen, Sigurd Sele, Fredrik Hermansen +
synopsis: When a couple of badass guys are going to break into a bank, they quickly realise the terrible mistake it was to involve “Premium Idiot” Klaus as part of the group.

films.title: Maelstrom
synopsis: Karl spins the spoon from his coffee. Something spins even faster inside Tony’s head.

films.title: Crack
credits: Cast – Patrick Shearer, Mark Edwards, Bernadette Meenach
synopsis: Crack is a black comedy short film about Douglas Hayes, a stoner who works for his father at their family-owned funeral home. When Doug mixes drugs with his work, he finds himself in a precarious situation after his stash finds its way into one of the bodies. Doug goes to extreme lengths in order to retrieve his stash, and thus, hilarity ensues.

films.title: Horn Hubb
credits: Cast – Chris Dawes, Niall Connan-Jackson, Esther Rosenberg +
synopsis: Two dedicated intelligence officers have discovered how international terrorists communicate & coordinate. Their findings will arouse more than just suspicion.

films.title: Unleavened Bread
credits: Cast – Pablo Pauly, Edith Le Merdy, Luc Antoine +
synopsis: Vanessa is in love with Rémi. Rémi is in love with Vanessa. Only one damper: his bread won’t rise…

films.title: Loose Narrative
credits: Cast – Jack McCafferty, Kevin Davenport, Kevin Giles
synopsis: After his subject tosses him to the side, a disembodied narrator searches to find a new person to narrate.

films.title: Why So Sirius
credits: Cast – Martina Šindelářová, Marie Turková & Tomáš Turek
synopsis: No help anywhere, no signal. Too far to reach anywhere on foot. Two scared women, one of whom ran over the husband of the other, will sooner or later have to deal with a situation in which no tested procedures apply. No natural patterns of behaviour. A black comedy about the absurdity of human interaction. About life and death. About cars, misunderstanding and a little bit about LARP.

films.title: Oddballs
credits: Cast – Aaron Gocs, Paul Tucker, Will Johnston +
synopsis: When members of the infamous Oddballs motorcycle club smell a rat in their crew, a witch hunt spirals out of control as they start to point fingers at each other.

films.title: Not Suitable For Children
credits: Cast – Gael Cárdenas, Oriol Rafel, Nuria Florensa
synopsis: A sad kid whose favourite toy has been broken by someone, or a man who wants vengeance for the brutal murder of an old friend? Everything depends on the point of view…

films.title: A Wreck in Paradise
credits: Cast – Bastien Guio, Léa Deneuville, Mamadou Gary +
synopsis: A drunken man who crashed his car finds himself in a strange Faustian bar with a stranger set of rules, but he might get the girl…
Fate is about to offer him his last chance.
Will he be able to seize it?
